title: Potion Combiner
description: Now you can combine several potions into one, merging all their effects into a single brew.
body:
Potion Combiner adds a new table capable of mixing up to three potions into a single bottle, combining and unifying all their effects to create much more powerful concoctions.

With this mod, you can combine any type of potion, both normal and splash, and merge their effects into a single bottle. To do this, a new table called Potion Blending Combiner is introduced, a special block created to mix different potions in a simple and intuitive way.

The table is constructed by surrounding a potion table with blocks placed in a ‘U’ shape, as shown in the image. Once in place, the table will react visually to the ingredients: its colour will change depending on the potion you add, indicating which effects you are about to merge.

The system allows you to mix up to 3 potions simultaneously, combining all their effects into a single final result. It is ideal for creating advanced potions that are more efficient and have multiple uses during your adventure.
